# Gnom-Hub

> Local multi-agent control hub — brainstorm freely, execute only when you press Execute.
> Desktop desk for AI agents. No Docker. Python · FastAPI.
> Not unattended full autonomy. Not a LangGraph drop-in.

## Start here

- Website: https://landjunge.github.io/gnom-hub-v1/
- Ecosystem (with Tollgate): https://landjunge.github.io/gnom-hub-v1/ecosystem.html
- [README](README.md) · [README DE](README_DE.md)
- [docs/INDEX.md](docs/INDEX.md)
- UI: http://127.0.0.1:8080/ after `./scripts/start.sh`

## Related

- Tollgate (agent safety layer): https://github.com/landjunge/tollgate
  Site: https://landjunge.github.io/tollgate/

## Product rule

Brainstorm freely. Execute only when you press Execute.

## Stack

- Python ≥ 3.10 · FastAPI · desktop SPA
- DeepSeek default · optional Ollama
- Keys in User/Key.txt
